items.title: Live updates: Binance says $6.34B set aside to cover hack losses
items.summary: Follow live updates as Binance says $6.3 billion in assets have been stolen in a major hack. Around $3 billion in stolen funds have been frozen.

items.title: Bitcoin price metrics hint at rebound as $1.6B liquidations follow Binance hack
items.summary: Bitcoin held above $76,000 after a $6.3 billion Binance hack and a tech-stock sell-off.

items.title: EIP-7702 didn't cause Binance hack, but may have amplified losses
items.summary: Security experts say attackers could have drained Binance's wallets without EIP-7702.

items.title: Binance Finds 'Additional Points of Breach' in $6.3B Hack
items.summary: CEO Richard Teng said the attack was not a single one-click action, about $3 billion frozen.

items.title: Trezor Warns CryptoBilis Buyers After Report of Hardware Implant in Safe 5
items.summary: The hardware wallet manufacturer is treating the report as credible and told buyers to move their funds.

items.title: Bitcoin slides below $77,000, BNB drops amid Binance hack
items.summary: BNB lost 7.1%, while Binance Co-CEO Yi He pledged that the exchange will cover all user losses.

items.title: Polymarket resumes trading after $2.65 million exploit
items.summary: After over $2.5 million was lost within minutes on Polymarket, the platform said it has since placed its exchange in cancel-only mode.

items.title: Crypto liquidations jump to $1.57 billion as Binance hack sends bitcoin, ether lower
items.summary: Bitcoin traded near $77,350 after $6.3 billion Binance hack, with crypto futures liquidations jumping to $1.57 billion.

items.title: Bitcoin Price Briefly Slides to $76,300 as Binance Confirms Hack Estimated at $6.3 Billion
items.summary: Binance says the attacker reportedly gained access through a compromised employee laptop, and about $3 billion has been frozen onchain.

items.title: Bitcoin mining difficulty hits 148 trillion as revenues fall to three-month lows
items.summary: At October 30's hashprice, a 25 J/TH rig covers power costing about 5.45 cents/kWh after an assumed 2% pool fee.
